create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Basel
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Basel is a small shala on the first floor of a building on the Spalenring in Basel, run by Lladiu de la Mata. Lladiu first met yoga in 2003 as a student in Asturias and went on to train in Sivananda hatha yoga, Ashtanga, Satyananda's yoga nidra and Iyengar yoga; after several long stays in Mysore he became an authorised Ashtanga teacher there, and in 2016 he assisted at a Mysore yoga institute. He teaches in German, English, Spanish, Asturian and Catalan.

The weekly timetable mixes traditional Ashtanga with alignment-based hatha yoga: short and full led Ashtanga classes, a session that begins led and continues Mysore style, a gentler guided class that ends in yoga nidra, Saturday self-practice in the open room, and hatha and restorative classes at several levels. A two-hour themed workshop is held on one Sunday morning each month, free to members, and Lladiu leads yoga holidays abroad, including a week in Andalusia timed for the total solar eclipse of August 2027. Members can also attend classes at a partner Iyengar studio in the city, and the shala gives 2% of its profit to charitable organisations.

courses.title: Ashtanga and hatha classes: memberships and class cards
courses.description: Access to the full weekly timetable of led and Mysore-style Ashtanga, hatha, restorative and yoga nidra classes, with unlimited memberships or ten-class cards. Reduced rates apply for students, people on low incomes and pensioners, and members use the Saturday self-practice room free.
courses.price: Probemonat CHF 100; Einzellektion CHF 30/20; 1 Monat unlimitiert CHF 180/120; 12 Monate unlimitiert CHF 1500/1000; 10er-Karte CHF 270/180 (reduced price after the slash)

courses.title: Monthly Sunday workshops
courses.description: Two-hour themed workshops held from ten to noon on one Sunday each month, giving time to look closely at one aspect of the practice. Free for members; the next listed date is Sunday 22 November 2026.

courses.title: Yoga Retreat & Eclipse, Cabo de Gata (Almería, Andalusia)
courses.description: A week on a country estate in Almería with Lladiu de la Mata: morning yoga sessions and restorative evening classes, two vegan meals a day, free time to explore, and a trip on the final day to watch the total solar eclipse. Open to beginners and experienced students.
